meta.source: Generic demonstration rubric written for LINGUA. Replace with your own evaluation criteria.

criteria.title: Fluency & coherence
criteria.description: Speaks at length without long pauses; ideas connect logically.

criteria.title: Lexical resource
criteria.description: Uses a range of words and phrases appropriately.

criteria.title: Pronunciation
criteria.description: Is easy to understand; uses stress and intonation naturally.
